about: Bitmaps that scripts/check-fidelity.mjs lets through, each with the reason it is a bitmap by nature (a photo, a screenshot, a picture about pixels). A chart or a diagram never belongs here: draw it as SVG.

bitmaps.figures/elf_1bit.png: L03: a picture about pixels, the same image at 1 bit per pixel
bitmaps.figures/elf_2bit.png: L03: a picture about pixels, 2 bits per pixel
bitmaps.figures/elf_3bit.png: L03: a picture about pixels, 3 bits per pixel
bitmaps.figures/elf_4bit.png: L03: a picture about pixels, 4 bits per pixel
bitmaps.figures/elf_24bit.jpg: L03: a picture about pixels, 24 bits per pixel
bitmaps.figures/light_bulb_off.png: L03: a photo, a bit as a switch; 512 px, shown at h-65 (260 px of the 980-px slide, 510 px on a 1920-px screen): no larger than its pixels
bitmaps.figures/light_bulb_on.png: L03: a photo, a bit as a switch; 1200x1600 px, shown at the same height as the off bulb
bitmaps.figures/gpu1.webp: L15: a photo of a graphics card, its VRAM chips outlined; 1500 x 900 px, 3.4x its 440 x 264 on a 1280 x 720 slide
bitmaps.figures/first_transistor.jpg: L03: a photo of the first transistor (1947); 1000x896 px, shown 31rem wide (496 px of the 980-px slide, 972 px on a 1920-px screen): no larger than its pixels
